title: Display-column wrap/truncate/pad with wide CJK characters and unsplittable combining clusters

hidden_checks.spec: Rule 1: width must be an int >= 2, else ValueError.
Rule 4: a word joins the line if text_width(line) + 1 + text_width(word) <= width.
Rule 3: words are maximal runs of non-space characters, joined by exactly one space, no leading/trailing spaces.
Rule 2: split on \n; a paragraph with no words produces exactly one empty line; wrap('', 5) == [''], wrap('ab\n', 5) == ['ab', ''].
Rule 4 with widths from termtext.width (CJK = 2 columns).
Rule 4 with widths from termtext.width (combining marks = 0 columns).
Rule 4 with widths from termtext.width (fullwidth = 2 columns).
Definitions: space means U+0020 only; ZWJ is zero width (termtext.width).
Rule 6: every returned line has display width <= width; rule 3 only spaces are dropped.
Rule 5: a word wider than width starts on a new line and is broken into chunks.
Rule 5: the last chunk becomes the current line and following words may join it under rule 4.
Rule 5: each chunk takes as many whole clusters as fit in width columns.
Rule 5: a two-column cluster that does not fit in the one remaining column goes to the next chunk.
Definitions: clusters (base + following zero-width chars) are never split by wrap.
Definitions: a space means U+0020 only (the ideographic space U+3000 is an ordinary character).
Rule 8: if text_width(text) <= width, return text unchanged.
Rule 9: longest prefix whose width <= width - text_width(ellipsis), followed by ellipsis (default '…').
Rule 9: trailing spaces removed from the prefix before the ellipsis.
Rule 9 with widths from termtext.width.
Rule 9: prefix made of whole clusters (combining marks stay with their base).
Rule 9: custom ellipsis; ellipsis='' is allowed.
Rule 7: width must be an int >= 0 and text_width(ellipsis) <= width, else ValueError.
Rule 10: exactly width display columns; center puts extra // 2 before and the rest after.
Rule 10: padding measured in display columns (combining marks = 0).
Rule 10: text already width columns or wider is returned unchanged; any other align raises ValueError.
